user: I prefer not to use any animal products for my home furnishings.
assistant:  I understand. There are many furniture options available that do not use any animal products. Here are some materials you can look for when shopping for furniture:

1. Wood: Look for furniture made of sustainably sourced wood, such as oak, maple, or cherry. Make sure to ask if any animal-derived products, such as animal glue, were used in the construction of the piece.
2. Metal: Metal furniture, such as iron or aluminum, is a great option for those looking to avoid animal products.
3. Fabric: Look for furniture upholstered in synthetic fabrics, such as polyester or nylon. There are also many plant-based fabrics, such as cotton, linen, or hemp, that are good options. Just make sure to check the label to ensure that no animal-derived products were used in the manufacturing process.
